record.one_liner: Global crypto exchange offering spot, margin, and futures trading and market data via REST and WebSocket APIs.
record.auth_notes: API keys are created in the account dashboard. Key types are Ed25519 (recommended), HMAC and RSA; requests are signed with the private key or secret, which is why 'other' is also listed.
record.access_notes: Free to create keys, but the FAQ says a deposit into the Spot Account and identity verification are required first. No vendor approval step was seen.
record.api_notes: Spot REST API plus separate derivatives (USDS-M and COIN-M futures), margin, convert and WebSocket APIs on the developer docs site.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve keys and a documented public API. Prerequisites are a deposit and KYC. Trading through the API moves real money, so keep test use on sandbox or read-only keys.
